items.title: Build experiments/pos-instrument-replay/run-batch.mjs: for each scale in {small,full}, run N (from protocol.json) independent generate+verify cycles into fresh mkdtemp dirs, appending one identity-keyed proof-or-stop record per iteration to batch-ledger.jsonl (proof: iterationId/arm/scale/verifyStatus/verifyFlags/digests{records,gold,manifest}/goldMetrics/elapsedMs/endOfRunRss/env/recordDigest; stop: iterationId/stopReason/rawError?/env/recordDigest). recordDigest = sha256 of canonical JSON with recordDigest absent
items.context: iterationId = replay/<scale>/<index> (index 1..N) per protocol.iterationIdRule. Digests sourced from the generation-side result. Reuse lib/instrument.mjs. A verify crash maps to a stop record with stopReason=verify_crash. Append-only: never rewrite an existing ledger line.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/run-batch.mjs prints per-iteration progress and writes batch-ledger.jsonl (one identity-keyed proof/stop record per iteration across small N=30 + full N=3); ends 'campaign complete: <N> records, 0 recordless'.

happy.desc: node run-batch.mjs runs N generate+verify cycles per scale (from protocol.json) into mkdtemp dirs and appends one proof-or-stop record per iteration to batch-ledger.jsonl with iterationId, verifyStatus, verifyFlags, generation-side digests, goldMetrics, elapsedMs, endOfRunRss, env, recordDigest

edge.desc: digests are sourced from the generation side; recordDigest = sha256 of canonical JSON with recordDigest absent, re-derivable per record

adversarial.desc: a verify crash (structural corruption) maps to a stop record with stopReason=verify_crash, not a recordless iteration or an uncaught throw

items.title: Proof-or-stop + lockfile discipline: every iteration ends in EXACTLY one record (proof XOR stop); the driver takes a lockfile so a concurrent second driver records precondition_failed instead of corrupting the ledger; run-batch.mjs exits nonzero if any iteration ends recordless
items.context: The lockfile is released on clean exit. The recordless-exit-nonzero property is load-bearing (a missing record must never be silently tolerated). H1 evidence = pairwise records/gold/manifest digest + gold-metric equality across the proof records at each scale; H4 evidence = each proof record elapsedMs within budgetCapMsPerVerify OR a budget_cap stop.
items.userSees: run-batch.mjs exits 0 only when every iteration produced exactly one record (prints '0 recordless'); H1: replay proof records per scale are pairwise digest+metric identical; a concurrent second run-batch prints 'precondition_failed (lock held)' and records that stop; a recordless iteration forces nonzero exit.

happy.desc: every iteration ends in EXACTLY one record (proof XOR stop); H1 = pairwise records/gold/manifest digest + gold-metric equality across the replay proof records at each scale (0 drift)

edge.desc: H4 = every proof record elapsedMs within budgetCapMsPerVerify OR an explicit budget_cap stop; the driver holds a lockfile released on clean exit

adversarial.desc: a concurrent second driver records precondition_failed via the lockfile (does not corrupt the ledger); a recordless iteration makes run-batch exit nonzero

items.title: Add a hermetic mkdtemp-isolated selfcheck (selfcheck-m2.mjs) that exercises the budget_cap stop path with an injected sub-second cap, asserts a concurrent second driver gets precondition_failed via the lockfile, and asserts a recordless iteration forces a nonzero exit
items.context: Per plan section 7 selfchecks: the M2 selfcheck exercises the budget_cap stop path with an injected sub-second cap. Also negative-tests the lockfile (second driver -> precondition_failed) and the recordless-exit-nonzero guard. Hermetic: mkdtemp isolation, run by node <file>, small scale only for speed.
